mathematical_claims.anchor: There are infinitely many primes congruent to three modulo four.
So there are infinitely many primes congruent to one modulo four as well.
mathematical_claims.source_locator: Proof using the negative-one Legendre criterion

mathematical_claims.anchor: the series of reciprocal primes diverges
the primes have natural density zero.
mathematical_claims.source_locator: Density zero from CRT sieve and divergent prime reciprocals

mathematical_claims.anchor: The third claim is the prime number theorem.
mathematical_claims.source_locator: Precise asymptotic, stated explicitly without proof

description: Proves infinitely many primes in both odd residue classes modulo four, divergence of prime reciprocals, and zero natural density; derives a doubling-interval upper bound without proving the prime number theorem.
